findings.title: REFRESH issued while banks still have open rows
findings.detail: Under refresh stress (CSR programs tREFI = 512 nCK and max_postpone = 2, then 600 back-to-back host writes), the scheduler grants refresh while banks it has activated are still open. The path checkers reconstruct bank state from the observed DDR command stream (ACT opens, PRE / PRE-all closes) and report REF_002 on 12 of the 22 refresh requests in path_05 and 10 in path_20; the design's own bank_tracker coverpoint cp_ref_002_exercised sees the same event. JESD79-3 requires all banks precharged before REFRESH. The scheduler must precharge open banks (or wait for their precharge) before acknowledging ref_required.

findings.title: Command issued before tRFC elapsed after REFRESH
findings.detail: In the same refresh-stress runs the independent tRFC assertion (a_TIMING_011, Validation/sva/generated/cmd_gen_sva.sv, bound recomputed from timing_model.tRFC = 160 ns = 32 controller cycles) fired 24 times and the cp_trfc_spacing illegal bin was hit 18 times: the scheduler resumes ACT/RD/WR within tRFC of a REFRESH. This is a distinct defect from the refresh-while-open-banks one above: the first is about what precedes a REFRESH, this is about what follows it. Note the run also reproduces the previously filed scheduler re-grant defect (a_TIMING_004 956x, a_PROTO_002 977x, p_faw 1022x) at a far higher rate under sustained traffic; those are not re-filed here.

findings.title: ref_pending_cnt is 3 bits wide but max_postpone is programmable to 8: the refresh-starvation antecedent cannot be represented
findings.detail: CTRL_STATUS.ref_pending_cnt occupies bits 7:5 (values 0-7) while REFRESH_CONFIG.max_postpone is documented as 0-8 with reset value 8. The starvation condition REF_001 (pending count exceeding max_postpone) is therefore unreachable at the reset configuration by construction, and the coverpoint cg_refresh.cp_ref_001_exercised (VP_FAIL_012) reads 0% even under refresh stress. Under stress with max_postpone = 2 the antecedent is representable but still never occurs, because the scheduler acknowledges every refresh request immediately (39 acks for 22 requests) instead of postponing — the same behaviour that produces the REF_002 defect above. Either the status field must be 4 bits wide or the postpone budget must be capped at 7; the spec should state which.
